title: pocket
body:
## pocket

Remove material from the current Body tip using an unused owned closed profile. Finite length gives a recess depth in mm; throughAll follows all intersected stock along the selected direction. Forward follows the profile normal, backward opposes it and symmetric cuts on both sides. A top-face profile normally cuts backward. A finite cut is blind only if stock remains beneath it; native execution requires a positive removal and one valid remaining solid.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Pocket`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `extent` | Defaults to throughAll: native ThroughAll follows changed stock thickness. Choose length for native Length and provide length or drive.length. A finite cut may pass through thinner stock; unsupported UpToFace, two-sided and symmetric modes are rejected. | `{"type":"enum","values":["throughAll","length"]}` | `"throughAll"` |
| `length` | Finite removal depth in millimetres, strictly positive and at most 100000. Required with extent length unless driven by drive.length; omit for throughAll. There is no default depth. The cavity remains blind only while this value is less than the remaining stock thickness. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `direction` | Forward (default) follows the profile normal; backward opposes it; symmetric spans both sides. A top-face Pocket normally cuts backward. Finite symmetric length is the total span. | `{"type":"enum","values":["forward","backward","symmetric"]}` | omitted |
